name: Autopsy 1
description: When anyone carrying your diseases dies within 9 tiles of you, you harvest 8 ichor for each of your diseases, and it's death burst widens from 3 to 5 tiles.

name: Bloodletting 1
description: A basic attack that strikes the first enemy up to 4 tiles in front of you, and feeds your ichor (more if they're diseased).
